summary.text: Gene Dornink is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 23 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Angie Hanson.
He is a carpenter who has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2021.

paragraphs.text: Dornink was born in Minnesota and works as a carpenter.
His Ballotpedia profile lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2021 and his current term as beginning on January 3, 2023, and notes that he advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
